note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Japanese, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-ja-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-ja). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-19: Japanese quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '……'; verbatim recitations without quote marks are quotations too. `self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases in the preacher's own voice, left as prose, or places named in `why` where the preacher argues from wording OWB does not carry.
